Hi Vivek / Asha — thanks for the patience. We completed the initial investigation and here's a concise summary and proposed remediation: 

Summary of root cause:
- On 2026-11-19 at 23:04 UTC a transient S3 ingest error caused a small partition (~47k documents across 3 tenants) to fail to reach the vectorization pipeline. Our backfill/replay orchestrator retried the failed batch on 2026-11-19 23:57 UTC; the replay correctly reprocessed records and produced ~14,132 embed tokens that were billed as a one-time 'embed-backfill' line.

Per-entity apportionment (sample):
- BridgePay-main (tenant id bp-main): 8,612 tokens -> 0.0009 USD/token -> $7.75
- BridgePay-eu (tenant id bp-eu): 4,320 tokens -> $3.89 (VAT routing note follows)
(Full CSV attached: token_apportionment_bp_202611.csv)

VAT / invoicing guidance:
- Because our invoice for BridgePay was issued by Redwood Inc (US entity) and the billing address on file is the US HQ, VAT was applied to the EU tenant charge by default. 
- If BridgePay wants VAT handled at the EU entity (zero-rated at Redwood level and reversed charged to EU entity), we need a valid EU VAT registration number and a billing override so future invoices are routed to Redwood EU entity. We can reissue the November invoice net of VAT for the bp-eu portion once we have that documentation.

Provisional credit request:
- We're proposing a provisional credit of $11.64 (net) to cover the bp-eu token portion pending VAT docs; for the bp-main portion ($7.75) we recommend a $7.75 credit given the unexpected nature of the backfill. Total provisional credit: $19.39.
- David, please confirm approval path. If < $5k, Lauren can issue the credit from billing pending a standard post-mortem.

Next steps:
- Asha: if you'd like VAT removed for bp-eu, please send the EU VAT number and a billing contact for entity takeover.
- Ben: please provide quick notes on mitigation steps to prevent the same partition replays (we should include guardrails in the orchestrator).
- Vivek: I'll prepare a short client-facing breakdown and reissue proforma on approval.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: token_apportionment_bp_202611.csv (csv, 1.9KB)
